# ProductGurus

> A Vancouver research and build studio for small business owners and founders. Product, feasibility, location, and competitor research that ends in a build, wait, or no decision; build briefs and product ownership when the answer is build; websites and local SEO when it's time to be found. Seven of our own products taken from research to release. No e-commerce stores, no paid ads. Prices quoted after a 30-minute call.

Contact: productgurus@proton.me · https://calendly.com/productgurus-proton/30min

## Services
- [Services hub](https://productgurus.ai/services): all eight services, three families, how the work runs
- [Product research](https://productgurus.ai/services/product-research): customer interviews, personas grounded in interviews, findings that change the plan
- [Feasibility research](https://productgurus.ai/services/feasibility-research): market sizing (TAM/SAM/SOM), unit economics, technical check, build / wait / no recommendation
- [Location and demography research](https://productgurus.ai/services/location-research): who lives, works, and spends near an address; foot traffic and transit; shortlist with a recommendation
- [Competitor benchmarking](https://productgurus.ai/services/competitor-benchmarking): positioning, pricing, features, reviews, side-by-side report
- [Build brief](https://productgurus.ai/services/build-brief): requirements workshop, process mapping, user stories with acceptance criteria, PRD, vendor selection
- [Product ownership](https://productgurus.ai/services/product-ownership): backlog, roadmap, UAT, fractional product owner
- [Websites](https://productgurus.ai/services/websites): search-ready service and brochure sites, scored website audit, analytics and search setup; no e-commerce
- [Local SEO](https://productgurus.ai/services/local-seo): Google Business Profile, citations, review collection, local landing page
- [Engagements](https://productgurus.ai/engagements): shapes and typical timelines (research sprint 2 weeks; prototype 3–4 weeks; website 2–3 weeks; retainer monthly)

## Case studies
- [ShiftFlow PRO](https://productgurus.ai/projects/shiftflow): retail workforce scheduler, in production at v2.5, zero scheduling grievances since launch
- [Scrutas](https://productgurus.ai/projects/scrutas): internal audit platform, 23 modules, two-stage authorization model
- [Squint](https://productgurus.ai/projects/squint): website audit to client-ready pitch in under two minutes; pricing tested at $79–$249/month
- [Council of AIs](https://productgurus.ai/projects/council-of-ais): open-source budget-driven multi-model router, MIT licence, 47 tests
- [Dwell](https://productgurus.ai/projects/dwell): renter trust score for Canadian newcomers; 9 interviews, discovery in progress
- [PavIQ](https://productgurus.ai/projects/paviq): fleet-mounted road-condition sensing, validated concept, CAD $580 bill of materials
- [GridSentinel](https://productgurus.ai/projects/gridsentinel): battery-free grid-edge outage sensor, validated concept, about CAD $95 per node
